create_grpc_server: create a gRPC server with a thread pool, generic RPC handlers, interceptors, and options
add_insecure_port: add an insecure port to the gRPC server by binding it to a given address string
add_secure_port: add a secure port to the gRPC server using server credentials and an address string
start_and_stop_server: start the gRPC server and later stop it with an optional grace period for shutdown
handle_unary_unary_rpc: handle a unary-unary RPC call by receiving a single request and sending a single response
